entities.summary:
Alfred Marshall Bailey was an American ornithologist who was associated with the Denver Museum of Natural History 
in Colorado for most of his working life. Alfred Marshall Bailey was a naturalists & biologists from Iowa City (1894-02-18, Iowa City–1978-02-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
